mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in GDPC1, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 YoY growth accelerates by more than 2%, but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points in one month signals a rapidly weakening labor market, which will pressure consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 1 month, but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) declines by more than 1% month-over-month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is already above 7%, it signals a supply-driven economic slowdown that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Trigger condition met, but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and rising by more than 0.25 percentage points per month, it signals a tightening monetary policy that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Trigger condition met, but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) decline by more than 10% year-over-year and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) are also in a YoY decline, it signals a weakening consumer demand environment that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST declines > 10% YoY and RSAFS in YoY decline
failure_condition: Trigger condition met, but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment (PAYEMS) declines month-over-month for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening labor market that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS declines MoM for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: Trigger condition met, but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) rises by more than 0.5% month-over-month for two consecutive months, it signals an inflationary environment that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL rises > 0.5% MoM for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: Trigger condition met, but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP (GDPC1) declines quarter-over-quarter and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is rising, it signals an economic contraction that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 declines QoQ and UNRATE rising
failure_condition: Trigger condition met, but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 40% of triggered instances.
